title: Glowing house
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='38' ry='30' fill='#2a1a40' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='50,20 15,48 85,48' fill='#ff6b35'/>
  <polygon points='50,20 15,48 50,48' fill='#ff8c5a'/>
  <!-- roof glow edge -->
  <polyline points='15,48 50,20 85,48' fill='none' stroke='#ffaa77' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='65' y='24' width='9' height='18' fill='#d94f2b'/>
  <rect x='63' y='22' width='13' height='4' fill='#ff8c5a'/>
  <!-- smoke -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='16' r='3' fill='#5a4a70' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#5a4a70' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- house body -->
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='60' height='40' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='20' y='48' width='30' height='40' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='22' rx='2' fill='#7a3b1e'/>
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='8' height='22' rx='2' fill='#9a5a30'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- door glow -->
  <rect x='42' y='66' width='16' height='22' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#ffaa55' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- left window -->
  <rect x='27' y='56' width='12' height='10' rx='1' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <rect x='27' y='56' width='12' height='10' rx='1' fill='#ffeeba' opacity='0.9'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='56' x2='33' y2='66' stroke='#7a3b1e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='27' y1='61' x2='39' y2='61' stroke='#7a3b1e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- right window -->
  <rect x='61' y='56' width='12' height='10' rx='1' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <rect x='61' y='56' width='12' height='10' rx='1' fill='#ffeeba' opacity='0.9'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='56' x2='67' y2='66' stroke='#7a3b1e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='61' y1='61' x2='73' y2='61' stroke='#7a3b1e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- base glow -->
  <rect x='16' y='86' width='68' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffaa55' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- window glows -->
  <rect x='27' y='56' width='12' height='10' rx='1' fill='none' stroke='#ffdd88' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='61' y='56' width='12' height='10' rx='1' fill='none' stroke='#ffdd88' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
